statement: Between 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-17, a Russian drone or missile strike damages at least one Kyiv Dnipro road bridge other than Pivdennyi and Pivnichnyi, namely the Paton, Metro, Darnytskyi or Podilskyi bridge.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters, AP or BBC, citing Kyiv city authorities, report a Russian strike damaging the Paton, Metro, Darnytskyi or Podilskyi bridge between 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-17; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: None of the Paton, Metro, Darnytskyi or Podilskyi bridges in Kyiv is damaged by a Russian strike between 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-17.

statement: Between 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-25, Ethiopian federal forces or the allied Tigray Peace Force take control of Mekelle city itself, not only its Alula Aba Nega airport.
resolution: TRUE if AP, Reuters or BBC report between 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-25 that Ethiopian federal forces or the Tigray Peace Force control Mekelle city, beyond the airport; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Mekelle city is not under federal or Tigray Peace Force control at any point between 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-25.

statement: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva is elected president of Brazil, either outright in the 2026-10-04 first round or in the scheduled 2026-10-25 runoff.
resolution: TRUE if official TSE results show Lula above 50 percent of valid votes on 2026-10-04 or winning the 2026-10-25 runoff; any other outcome is FALSE.
failure_condition: A candidate other than Lula is elected president of Brazil on 2026-10-04 or 2026-10-25.

statement: At its scheduled 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28 meeting, the FOMC raises the federal funds target range above 3.75 to 4.00 percent. Reference: 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the 2026-10-28 FOMC statement raises the target range, confirmed by FRED series DFEDTARU above 4.00 on 2026-10-29; unchanged or lower is FALSE. Reference: 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The FOMC holds the target range at 3.75 to 4.00 percent or lowers it at the 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28 meeting.

statement: In the scheduled 2026-10-27 Knesset election, Likud, Shas, United Torah Judaism, Otzma Yehudit and Religious Zionism-Zehut together win 61 or more of the 120 seats.
resolution: TRUE if Central Elections Committee official final results for the 2026-10-27 election give Likud, Shas, United Torah Judaism, Otzma Yehudit and Religious Zionism-Zehut a combined 61 or more seats; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The five named lists win a combined 60 or fewer seats in the 2026-10-27 Knesset election.

statement: The ICE Brent front-month futures contract settles below 100.00 USD per barrel on 2026-11-13. Reference: 102.25 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the ICE Futures Europe Brent front-month settlement price for 2026-11-13 is below 100.00 USD per barrel; 100.00 or higher is FALSE. Reference: 102.25 on the packet date.
failure_condition: The ICE Brent front-month settlement on 2026-11-13 is 100.00 USD per barrel or higher.

statement: Between 2026-10-04 and 2026-11-30, the National Hurricane Center classifies at least one Atlantic-basin tropical cyclone as a hurricane.
resolution: TRUE if an NHC advisory issued between 2026-10-04 and 2026-11-30 UTC assigns hurricane intensity, sustained winds of 64 knots or more, to any Atlantic-basin cyclone; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No Atlantic-basin tropical cyclone reaches hurricane intensity between 2026-10-04 and 2026-11-30.

statement: Between 2026-10-04 and 2026-12-31, a royal decree dissolving the Cortes Generales and calling an early Spanish general election is published in the Boletin Oficial del Estado.
resolution: TRUE if the BOE publishes, between 2026-10-04 and 2026-12-31, a royal decree dissolving the Congress of Deputies and Senate and calling a general election; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: The Cortes Generales are not dissolved between 2026-10-04 and 2026-12-31.

statement: Between 2026-10-04 and 2026-12-31, at least one person arrested over the 2026-09-27 RAF Fairford incident is charged with a criminal offence in the UK.
resolution: TRUE if Counter Terrorism Policing or the CPS announces, between 2026-10-04 and 2026-12-31, a criminal charge against anyone arrested over the RAF Fairford incident, as reported by BBC, Reuters or the Guardian; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No person arrested over the RAF Fairford incident is charged with any offence between 2026-10-04 and 2026-12-31.

statement: Between 2026-10-04 and 2027-01-29, CISA adds at least one of the six newly patched Dell Container Storage Modules vulnerabilities, including CVSS 10.0 CVE-2026-63688 and CVE-2026-63692, to the KEV catalog.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog lists a dateAdded between 2026-10-04 and 2027-01-29 for CVE-2026-63688, CVE-2026-63692, CVE-2026-54472, CVE-2026-61421, CVE-2026-67269 or CVE-2026-67273; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: None of the six Dell Container Storage Modules CVEs is added to the KEV catalog between 2026-10-04 and 2027-01-29.
